summary: All round-1 findings (2 major + 3 minor) are properly addressed in commit 4c85960; both suggestions are also applied at code level (errorBodies 422/404 tightening) with the patterns.md/decisions.md write-up correctly deferred per the round-1 fix's own guidance. Test count grew 68 -> 69 with the new IT getProject_singleHappyPath_returns200WithProjectResponseShape pinning the end-to-end DB->DTO path.

round1_findings_status.round1_issue_short: anyEndpoint_unauthenticatedBareClient_returns401 not bare and 4 of 6 verbs relaxed to is4xxClientError
round1_findings_status.note: Now constructs `WebTestClient.bindToApplicationContext(applicationContext).build()` (ApplicationContext autowired on the class), pre-attaches `mutateWith(csrf())` on POST/PATCH/DELETE/POST-restore, and asserts `isUnauthorized()` on all six verbs. Auth-before-CSRF intent of AC-11 is now locked.

round1_findings_status.round1_issue_short: Response-shape lock $.ownerId.doesNotExist() missing on six PATCH/RESTORE handlers + no GET-single happy-path IT
round1_findings_status.note: Added `$.ownerId.doesNotExist()` to all six identified happy-path bodies (PATCH no-name-change, PATCH no-op same-name, PATCH blank description, PATCH blank timezone, RESTORE happy, RESTORE collision). New IT `getProject_singleHappyPath_returns200WithProjectResponseShape` exercises real DB->entity->DTO and asserts the full ProjectResponse shape.

Replaced with new `saveActiveAt(ownerId, name, timezone, createdAt)` helper and explicit `Instant.parse("2026-05-10T10:00:00Z")` / `:01Z` timestamps. Sort is now deterministic regardless of clock resolution.

round1_findings_status.round1_issue_short: restoreProject_onActiveProject_* should assert no project_* event (broader contract) for projectId
round1_findings_status.note: Single `assertThat(all).noneMatch(e -> eventMatchesProject(e, active.getId()))` replaces the two-event check. Helper `eventMatchesProject` null-guards getMetadata() once and keys on `eventType.startsWith("project_")` plus metadata.projectId match — exactly the broader Decision 14 contract requested.

round1_findings_status.round1_issue_short: update_noOpRenameSameName_doesNotThrow409 missing metadata-shape and never-rename verifies
round1_findings_status.note: Now captures metadata via `metadataCaptor()` and asserts `containsOnlyKeys("projectId")`, plus `verify(eventService, never()).logEvent(anyString(), eq("project_renamed"), anyString(), anyString(), any())`. Both regressions named in round-1 are now pinned.

round1_findings_status.round1_issue_short: Slice mocks empirical result (0 needed) should land in decisions.md / patterns.md
round1_findings_status.note: Round-1 fix itself flagged this as a post-completion artifact (decisions.md / patterns.md edit). Correctly deferred — does not block this PR; is a project-knowledge update tracked separately. Class-level comment in the slice test already documents the empirical result inline.

round1_findings_status.round1_issue_short: errorBodies_alwaysHaveMessageAndCode missing 422 arm; 404/400 arms don't pin code=null
round1_findings_status.note: Added 422 arm (seeds 4 active projects, 5th POST asserts isEqualTo(422) + `$.code == "project_limit_reached"`). Tightened 400 and 404 arms with `.jsonPath("$.code").isEqualTo(null)` to lock the GlobalErrorHandler null-code contract. AC-T1 now covers all four status codes end-to-end.

non_findings: Test count is 69 (was 68): the new `getProject_singleHappyPath_returns200WithProjectResponseShape` is the only added test — matches the orchestrator's accounting (38 -> 39 IT).
All round-1 fixes preserve existing assertions and add narrowly-scoped checks; no test was loosened or removed.

Helper extraction (`saveActiveAt`, `eventMatchesProject`) reduces duplication and improves future-test ergonomics — same arrangement style as the existing `saveActive` / `awaitEvent` / `findEvent` helpers.
